l0.speaker: narrator
l0.text: Sunday night in your dorm room. Quack is sitting on your pillow like it owns the place.

l1.speaker: quack
l1.text: Four weeks in, {player}, and... huh. All four of them like you. Like, a lot. So, have you picked one yet?

yes.speaker: quack
yes.text: You absolute multithreader. Fine. But keep all four happy, or this is going to crash. Hard.
